rationale: The requirement explicitly asks for a Dark 1980s neo-noir bulletin board system (BBS) with neon punk retro-futuristic dark aesthetics. This perfectly matches a modified Archetype 7. We prioritize deep void blacks, sharp geometric structures, glowing phosphor greens, electric cyan/magenta accents, and mandatory monospace typography to capture the terminal hacker vibe.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bbs tracking-widest text-[#39FF14] uppercase drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(57,255,20,0.6)]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bbs tracking-wide text-[#39FF14] uppercase
hierarchy.h3: text-xl font-mono font-medium text-[#FF00FF] uppercase tracking-[0.1em]

rules: No rounded corners on core structural panels (rounded-none).
1px solid borders everywhere to expose the grid skeleton.
Containers must use border-collapse style alignment to feel like a terminal application.

crt_monitor_effect.scanlines_overlay: pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 opacity-20 bg-[linear-gradient(to_bottom,rgba(255,255,255,0.04)_50%,rgba(0,0,0,0.18)_50%)] bg-[length:100%_4px] z-50

panel.classes: bg-[#080c08] border border-[#39FF14]/30 p-6 relative group

animations.glitch: Add chromatic aberration via text-shadows on hover (e.g., text-shadow: 2px 0 #FF00FF, -2px 0 #00FFFF)

buttons.primary: bg-transparent border border-[#39FF14] text-[#39FF14] hover:bg-[#39FF14] hover:text-black font-mono uppercase px-6 py-2 transition-colors duration-200 cursor-pointer shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(57,255,20,0.2)] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(57,255,20,0.6)] rounded-none
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#00FFFF]/50 text-[#00FFFF] hover:bg-[#00FFFF] hover:text-black font-mono uppercase px-4 py-2 transition-colors duration-200 rounded-none

prompt_console.structure: A black container with green border, preceded by a 'system@ai-bbs:~$' prompt, featuring a blinking block cursor.
prompt_console.classes: w-full bg-black border border-[#39FF14]/50 text-[#39FF14] font-mono p-4 outline-none focus:border-[#39FF14] focus:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(57,255,20,0.3)] resize-none

pipeline_visualization.style: Use ASCII arrows (===>) or solid 1px neon cyan lines to connect stages. Active stage blinks or has a glowing magenta border.
pipeline_visualization.stage_card: border border-[#39FF14]/30 p-4 relative. Include a small [STATUS: ACTIVE] blinking label at the top right.

artifact_viewer.classes: bg-[#000000] border-l-2 border-[#FF00FF] p-4 text-sm font-mono overflow-auto
artifact_viewer.syntax_highlighting: Keys in neon cyan (#00FFFF), Strings in amber (#FFB000), Brackets in muted green (#1F8A0E).

rater_scorecards.classes: flex items-center justify-between font-mono text-sm border-b border-[#39FF14]/20 py-2

lineage_timeline.style: Strict 90-degree orthogonal SVG lines (retro schematic style) connecting nodes. Nodes are square brackets around IDs, e.g., [GEN-001].
lineage_timeline.node_classes: border border-[#00FFFF] text-[#00FFFF] px-2 py-1 text-xs hover:bg-[#00FFFF] hover:text-black cursor-pointer

images.description: Dark 1980s neo-noir computer terminal room, glowing green phosphor screens. Use as full-page background with opacity-10 or opacity-20 behind the CRT layout, or inside the hero header panel.
Abstract neural network evolution tree. Use this image as a subtle background layer inside the Lineage Timeline or Rater Scorecards section to add cybernetic texture.

icons.instructions: Use sharp, angular icons if possible. Wrap icon components in a span with text-[#00FFFF] or text-[#FF00FF] to differentiate them from the green text. E.g. Terminal, Network, ShieldAlert, Zap.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='run-prompt-btn', data-testid='lineage-node-001').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure glowing text against the `#000000` background meets APCA contrast standards. Avoid using the muted green for interactive text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page interactive dashboard combining the prompt console, pipeline visualization, artifact viewer, and lineage tree.
Implement the CRT effect container at the root layout level so the entire app looks like a retro monitor.
Use custom Tailwind keyframes for the blinking cursor (blink) and subtle screen flicker (flicker).
DO NOT USE INTER, ROBOTO, or standard rounded Shadcn UI cards. Strip Shadcn border-radiuses to `rounded-none`.
Rely heavily on ASCII brackets, pipes, and hyphens to decorate headers, e.g., '=== [ SYSTEM STATUS ] ==='.
